text:
cami: Heads up — PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4122 updates dedicated/autoscale.md with a new 'burst' subsection and examples. I'm uneasy about the tenant-label YAML and the SLA wording. Can infra/serving or an SME confirm behavior before we merge?

sam: I can take a pass today. Quick Q: is 'burst_limit' per-tenant or per-pool?

praveen: It's per-pool. Controller charges credits at the pool level. We shouldn't suggest per-tenant enforcement. Example YAML should reflect pool-level keys.

cami: Got it. Current snippet uses tenant label, looks like this:

```yaml
autoscale:
  policy: burst
  burst_limit: 1000
  tenant_labels:
    - team: 'payments'
```

Can we instead make it explicit that burst is configured at pool scope, e.g.:

```yaml
autoscale:
  policy: burst
  burst_limit_per_pool: 1000
  tenant_selector:
    matchLabels:
      team: payments
```

elaine: +1 with praveen. Also: the SLA paragraph currently says "guaranteed latency under burst" which is too strong. Suggest rewording to "latency target under typical conditions; during sustained bursts, lower-tier fallbacks may apply." Add a short note about eviction: "Reserved tenants are not preempted; burst tenants may be evicted when credits are exhausted."

mike: docs-bot flagged a broken handbook link in the isolation section (was pointing to /dedicated/isolation).

docs-bot: link-checker: /dedicated/isolation -> 404 (reported at 1726001400). PR https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4130 fixes the handbook path.

cami: OK I'll update the PR: (1) replace tenant-focused YAML with pool-scoped example, (2) reword SLA line to use "target" and mention fallback, (3) add a brief eviction/isolation note, (4) fix handbook link to https://handbook.redwood.ai/dedicated/isolation. @elaine @praveen can you review after I push the edits? I'll also add a tiny example showing QPS vs burst-credit consumption.

sam: tiny nit: repo examples typically use snake_case for YAML keys. Keep snake_case (burst_limit_per_pool is fine).

praveen: Also add a CLI/SDK snippet showing how ops set burst on a pool, e.g.:

```bash
rw infra set-autoscale --policy burst --pool-id pool-123 --burst 1000
```

Note: CLI flag is `--burst` (not burst_limit_per_pool). Docs should show mapping between API keys, YAML keys, and CLI flags.

elaine: I'll +1 after those edits. If you want, I can push small wording tweaks directly to the branch.

cami: Thanks! Pushing changes in ~30m and will request reviews. Marking this thread resolved when PR updated. :thumbsup:
